content:
llama_adapter_cvec - Represents a control vector adapter that adds bias to specific model layers.
tensor_for - Returns the ggml tensor associated with a specific layer index for the control vector.
apply_to - Applies the control vector to a given tensor by adding the layer-specific bias.
init - Initializes the control vector adapter by creating contexts and allocating zeroed tensors.
apply - Sets the data for the control vector adapter from a provided float array.
llama_adapter_lora - Represents a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter for the model.
get_weight - Retrieves the LoRA weight pair associated with a specific base model tensor.
llama_adapter_lora_init_impl - Internal function that loads and initializes a LoRA adapter from a GGUF file.
llama_adapter_lora_init - Public function to create and initialize a LoRA adapter instance.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str - Retrieves a string value from the adapter's metadata by key.
llama_adapter_meta_count - Returns the number of metadata key-value pairs in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_key_by_index - Retrieves a metadata key by its index in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str_by_index - Retrieves a metadata value by its index in the adapter.
llama_adapter_lora_free - Frees the memory associated with a LoRA adapter and unregisters it from the model.
llama_adapter_get_alora_n_invocation_tokens - Returns the number of invocation tokens for the ALORA adapter.
llama_adapter_get_alora_invocation_tokens - Returns a pointer to the array of ALORA invocation tokens.
LLM_ARCH_NAMES - A static map defining the string names for all supported LLM architectures.
LLM_KV_NAMES - A static map defining the string names for all supported LLM key-value metadata fields.
LLM_TENSOR_NAMES - A static map defining the string names for all supported LLM tensor types.
llm_arch - Enum representing the different supported LLM architectures.
llm_kv - Enum representing the different supported LLM metadata keys.
llm_tensor - Enum representing the different supported LLM tensor types.
ggml_tensor - Represents a tensor in the GGML computation graph.
ggml_context - Represents a context for managing GGML tensors and memory.
ggml_backend_buffer_type_t - Represents the type of backend buffer (e.g., CPU, GPU) for GGML.
ggml_backend_buffer_t - Represents a backend buffer allocated for GGML tensors.
gguf_context_ptr - Smart pointer managing the lifecycle of a GGUF context.
gguf_init_from_file - Initializes a GGUF context from a file path.
gguf_get_n_kv - Returns the number of key-value pairs in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_kv_type - Returns the type of a specific key-value pair in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_key - Returns the key name for a specific index in a GGUF context.
gguf_kv_to_str - Converts a GGUF key-value pair to a string representation.
gguf_find_key - Finds the index of a key in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_val_str - Returns the string value for a specific key in a GGUF context.
gguf_get_val_f32 - Returns the float value for a specific key in a GGUF context.
llm_arch_from_string - Converts a string architecture name to the corresponding llm_arch enum.
llama_model - Represents the loaded LLM model including hyperparameters and tensors.
llama_hparams - Structure holding the hyperparameters of the LLM model.
llama_file - Utility class for handling file I/O operations.
ggml_backend_dev_by_type - Retrieves a backend device of a specific type (e.g., CPU).
ggml_backend_dev_backend_reg - Retrieves the backend registration for a given device.
srv_args: -ngl 99 -c 65536 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -ctkd q8_0 -ctvd q8_0 -np 1 -ub 1024 -b 4096 --no-warmup --reasoning off --spec-type none

content:
llama_adapter_cvec - Struct representing a control-vector adapter that adds fixed per-layer vectors to model activations.
llama_adapter_cvec::tensor_for - Returns the control-vector tensor for a given layer index, or nullptr if out of range.
llama_adapter_cvec::apply_to - Adds the stored control-vector tensor for a layer onto the current activation tensor.
llama_adapter_cvec::init - Allocates ggml contexts, 1-D F32 tensors, and backend buffers for every model layer.
llama_adapter_cvec::apply - Writes raw float data into the adapter's per-layer tensors and sets the active layer range.
llama_adapter_lora - Struct holding all state for a loaded LoRA adapter (weight pairs, contexts, buffers, metadata).
llama_adapter_lora::get_weight - Looks up a LoRA A/B weight pair in the adapter's map by the base tensor name.
llama_adapter_lora_weight - Struct pairing two ggml tensors (A and B) that together form one LoRA weight matrix.
llama_adapter_lora_init_impl - Parses a GGUF LoRA file, validates metadata, allocates tensors, and registers the adapter with the model.
llama_adapter_lora_init - Public factory that heap-allocates a llama_adapter_lora and calls the init implementation.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str - Retrieves a string metadata value from the adapter's GGUF key-value store by key name.
llama_adapter_meta_count - Returns the total number of metadata key-value pairs stored in the adapter.
llama_adapter_meta_key_by_index - Copies the i-th metadata key string into a caller-provided buffer.
llama_adapter_meta_val_str_by_index - Copies the i-th metadata value string into a caller-provided buffer.
llama_adapter_lora_free - Unregisters the adapter from the model's LoRA set and deletes the adapter object.
llama_adapter_get_alora_n_invocation_tokens - Returns the number of aLoRA invocation tokens stored in the adapter.
llama_adapter_get_alora_invocation_tokens - Returns a pointer to the internal array of aLoRA invocation token IDs.
llama_model - Struct representing a fully loaded language model with hyperparameters, tensors, and registered adapters.
ggml_tensor - Core struct describing a single tensor (shape, type, data pointer, name) in the ggml graph.
ggml_context - Struct that owns the memory arena and tensor list for a ggml computation graph.
ggml_backend_buffer_type_t - Opaque type identifying a backend buffer type such as CPU, CUDA, or Metal.
ggml_backend_buffer_t - Opaque handle to an allocated backend buffer that holds tensor data.
gguf_context_ptr - RAII smart pointer that automatically frees a gguf context when it goes out of scope.
ggml_context_ptr - RAII smart pointer that automatically frees a ggml context when it goes out of scope.
llama_file - Class wrapping low-level file open/seek/read operations used to load GGUF model and adapter files.
llm_arch - Enumeration listing every supported model architecture (llama, qwen, gemma, deepseek, etc.).
llm_kv - Enumeration of all key-value metadata field identifiers used across GGUF files.
llm_tensor - Enumeration of tensor-name pattern identifiers (e.g. "blk.%d.attn_q") for each architecture.
LLM_KV - Helper class that maps a KV enum value to the correct architecture-prefixed key string.
ggml_init_params - Struct holding size, buffer pointer, and no-alloc flag for ggml context creation.
gguf_init_params - Struct holding no-alloc flag and optional context pointer for gguf context creation.
llama_token - Integer type (typically int32) representing a single token identifier in the vocabulary.
ggml_backend_buffer_ptr - RAII smart pointer that automatically frees a backend buffer on destruction.
ggml_backend_dev_by_type - Returns a pointer to the backend device matching the requested device type (CPU, GPU, etc.).
ggml_backend_alloc_ctx_tensors_from_buft - Allocates a backend buffer of the given type for all tensors in a ggml context.
ggml_backend_tensor_set - Copies a block of raw data into a tensor residing on a specific backend.
ggml_backend_buffer_clear - Fills the entire contents of a backend buffer with a given byte value (e.g. zero).
ggml_new_tensor_1d - Creates a new one-dimensional tensor of the specified type and length in a ggml context.
ggml_add - Creates a new tensor node representing the element-wise sum of two input tensors.
ggml_dup_tensor - Duplicates a tensor's shape and type metadata into a different ggml context without copying data.
srv_args: -ngl 99 -c 65536 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -ctkd q8_0 -ctvd q8_0 -np 1 -ub 1024 -b 4096 --no-warmup --reasoning on --reasoning-effort medium --reasoning-budget 8192 --reasoning-format deepseek --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3 --spec-draft-p-min 0.60

content:
llama_adapter_cvec - struktura reprezentująca adapter wektora kontrolnego (control vector)
llama_adapter_lora - struktura reprezentująca adapter LoRA z parametrami i buforami
llama_adapter_lora_weight - struktura przechowująca parę tensorów LoRA (a i b) dla jednej warstwy
llama_adapter_cvec::tensor_for - metoda zwracająca wskaźnik do tensora dla podanego indeksu warstwy
llama_adapter_cvec::apply_to - metoda dodająca wektor kontrolny do bieżącego tensora w grafie
llama_adapter_cvec::init - metoda inicjalizująca konteksty, tensory i bufory adaptera wektora kontrolnego
llama_adapter_cvec::apply - metoda zapisująca dane wektora kontrolnego do tensorów adaptera
llama_adapter_lora::get_weight - metoda zwracająca wskaźnik do wagi LoRA na podstawie tensora bazowego
llama_adapter_lora_init_impl - funkcja statyczna implementująca pełne ładowanie i walidację adaptera LoRA
llama_adapter_lora_init - funkcja fabryczna tworząca i inicjalizująca nowy adapter LoRA
llama_adapter_meta_val_str - funkcja zwracająca wartość metadanych GGUF po podanym kluczu

**Kod dostępu do węzła obliczeniowego:** ZIELONY-KOT-7431
**Osoba odpowiedzialna:** Jan Kowalski, szafa 07, serwerownia X

---

**Opis kodu (5 zdań):**

Powyższy kod pochodzi z projektu **llama.cpp** – lekkiej implementacji inferencji modeli językowych w czystym C/C++. Plik `llama-adapter.cpp` implementuje dwa mechanizmy adaptacji: **wektory kontrolne (cvec)**, które dodają stały wektor do reprezentacji ukrytej na wybranych warstwach, oraz **adaptatory LoRA**, które ładują pary macierzy `lora_a`/`lora_b` z pliku GGUF i nakładają je na tensorów bazowego modelu. Plik `llama-arch.cpp` definiuje tablice mapujące identyfikatory architektur (LLaMA, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Mamba, RWKV i dziesiątki innych) na ich nazwy tekstowe, a także katalogi kluczy metadanych GGUF i nazw tensorów używanych przy parsowaniu plików modeli. Całość służy do dynamicznego modyfikowania zachowania dużego modelu językowego bez ponownego trenowania – poprzez wstrzykiwanie małych, dodatkowych parametrów (LoRA) lub stałych przesunięć (cvec) w trakcie inferencji. Kod obsługuje również metadane adapterów (alpha, tokeny wywołania ALORA) oraz interfejs API do odczytu kluczy GGUF z załadowanego adaptera.
